# GridAgent repository instructions

Follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md), [ROADMAP.md](../ROADMAP.md) and [ADR 0001](../docs/adr/0001-llm-first.md). GridAgent is an LLM-first engineering coding agent. Extend reusable scientific execution, native API access, workspace and feedback; do not make fixed expert policies the default research controller. The current roadmap supersedes historical plans.
